Subject: FinTechCorp — security / IR & BCP follow-up

Alex / security team — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and agreed next steps from our discovery: 

1) SOC 2 status: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report covering controls for the hosted API and Dedicated environments. We will share a redacted copy for procurement review (attached).

2) Data protection / regs: You mentioned GDPR + potential HIPAA applicability depending on the integration scope. We can provide our DPA and details on data residency/processing. Please flag which datasets you expect to send so we can confirm applicability.

3) Vendor security questionnaire: Attached is our standard security questionnaire template to kick things off. If you prefer a vendor portal or DocuSign route we can support that — link below.

4) Incident response & breach notification: High-level timeline we discussed: detection -> internal triage (hours), escalation to Legal/CS within 24 hours for incidents impacting data confidentiality, and customer notification targets within 72 hours for incidents requiring disclosure. We will include our incident response runbook excerpt and BCP/DR evidence in the attachments.

5) Action items / next steps:
- Soojin / Redwood: Share redacted SOC2, questionnaire template, and sample BCP/DR artifacts (attached) — by EOD today.
- Alex / FinTechCorp: Confirm security POC and preferred questionnaire upload method; indicate whether HIPAA applies and list the primary dataflows — target by 2026-08-17.
- Optional: schedule a 30-minute follow-up with our IR lead and engineering to walk through any technical controls.

Attachments: FinTech_Security_Questionnaire_Template.pdf; Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_Redacted_Q3_2026.pdf; BCP_DR_Evidence_2026.zip

Thanks — talk soon.

--
Soojin Lee
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Rodriguez <alex.rodriguez@fintechcorp.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@fintechcorp.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FinTechCorp — security / IR & BCP follow-up

Soojin — appreciate the recap and quick turnaround. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SOC2: we need the actual report (redacted is fine) for our procurement and cyber risk team. If there are carve-outs or excluded services, please call those out.

- HIPAA: at this stage we think HIPAA may apply to a subset of payloads. I'll confirm with legal, but please include any HIPAA-relevant controls and whether Redwood accepts a BAA or has a standard BAA template.

- IR / breach notification: Can you confirm the SLA/commitment in writing that Redwood will notify impacted customers within 72 hours of determining a reportable breach? Also include the IR POC (name/email/phone) and whether you engage external forensics.

- BCP/DR evidence: we typically request RTO/RPO metrics and recent DR test summaries (within last 12 months). Please include the last DR test date and outcomes.

- Questionnaire: preferred upload is via our secure vendor portal; if you send the questionnaire first we can pre-fill and send back. Also send a DocuSign link if we need to sign any forms.

Can you provide the SOC2 and questionnaire by EOD tomorrow? We aim to move to procurement approval the week of Aug 24 if everything checks out.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Rodriguez
Security Lead, FinTechCorp
alex.rodriguez@fintechcorp.com | +1 (617) 555-0199

Alex — thanks, noted. Sending the items you requested and confirming a few commitments below. Please find attachments and short answers inline.

1) SOC 2: attached is our SOC 2 Type II report (redacted). Excluded services: on-prem private installs are out of scope for that report — hosted API and Redwood Dedicated are covered.

2) HIPAA / BAA: Redwood supports BAAs for customers requiring HIPAA compliance. I'll loop Legal if you want a standard template; otherwise we can provide the BAA draft via DocuSign.

3) IR / breach notification commitment: Redwood's standard practice is to escalate internally within 24 hours of incident confirmation and notify impacted customers within 72 hours of determining a reportable breach. We will provide the IR POC and escalation contact: 
- IR Lead: Priya Natarajan (priya.natarajan@redwood.ai)
- Phone: +1 (415) 555-0210
We engage external DFIR partners for investigations when appropriate; engagement is on a case-by-case basis.

4) BCP/DR evidence: attached is a zip with recent DR test summaries, RTO/RPO targets for primary services, and a high-level excerpt of the runbook. Last full DR exercise: 2026-05-11 (planned failover to secondary region, objectives met; details in zip).

5) Questionnaire / upload: attached is the questionnaire template filled where possible. I'll also upload to your vendor portal if you send the link, or we can accept the portal upload instructions. DocuSign link for BAA: https://docusign.com/example/FT-4281-nda

Next steps: 
- You: confirm whether HIPAA applies and provide vendor portal link (or confirm you received attachments).
- FinTech security: complete the first pass of the questionnaire by 2026-08-17 so we can schedule the technical IR deep-dive on the week of 8/24 if needed.

If helpful, I can set a 30-minute call between your IR/legal lead and Priya to walk through the runbook — propose Tue 2026-08-25 10:00 AM ET (let me know if that works).

Best,

--
Soojin Lee
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
